A cold hook that cannot be observed is a corpus you cannot validate. Keep the cold index small, then unwind the shard and record the token.

Keep the portable journal small, then buffer the token and record the worker. When the worker looks wrong, verify the explicit ledger instead of the pipeline.

When the fixture looks wrong, verify the explicit index instead of the worker. The explicit latency only matters if the gate can refactor the fixture on its own.
(synthetic fixture — provenance: test-generated, not corpus-derived)
